title: Isimangaliso Sobufakazi Obuthule
intro: Uhlangana nendaba embozwe ngumuntu yokungenelela kukaNkulunkulu. Indaba yokuhlinzekwa okuyisimangaliso kanye nokuzivikela okungenamazwi okuphindaphindayo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ungayithola yini ukuthi obani ababhekene nalolu vivinyo olungavamile?
clues: Ngithole umyalezo ovela kuNkulunkulu owangishiya ngimangele
Abantu bami bangabaza ubumsulwa bami lapho ngibuya nomntwana
Ngayalwa ukuba ngizile ukudla ngenxa yokukhuluma isikhathi esithile
Umthombo wamanzi nama-date angisekele ngesikhathi secala lami
INkosi yami yenza ukunyakaziswa kwesihlahla okuyisimangaliso ukuze inginakekele
Ingelosi yabonakala kimi ngesimo somuntu ophelele

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ubumsulwa bami babonakala lapho indodana yami encane ikhuluma
outcome.answer: Ubumsulwa bami babonakala lapho indodana yami encane ikhuluma

verse: Then he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream. And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.' (Maryam 19:24-25)
arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا ﴿٢٤﴾ وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا ﴿٢٥﴾
